title: Synthetic private-data-safe service smoke
raw_text: Build a local smoke handoff for a synthetic service request while refusing to persist supplied endpoint or credential values and keeping all network access disabled.
business_goal: Verify that an environment-backed external connection design does not propagate private values and cannot become runnable until the current generator supports the reviewed boundary.
current_process: Accept a fixed synthetic service query
Refer only to approved environment-variable names
Use a deterministic local synthetic response for smoke evidence
Fail closed when external connector generation is requested
